subject: english
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select No error'.

At night, lying sleepless, he considered/ sending messengers besides the country, / secretly, in search of his friend.

options.text: secretly, in search of his friend.
At night, lying sleepless, he considered

solution:
The correct answer is "**sending messengers besides the country.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The phrase "besides the country" is incorrect**. 

 
 
• ​ "Besides" means "in addition to" or "apart from" which does not fit the context of the sentence.(अलावा) 
 
 
 
• It should be "outside" the country.
 
 
• ​"Outside" means the outer part of something. (बाहर)​
 
 
 
• As, the subject thought of sending the messengers outside the country to search his friend.
 
• The sentence should read:
 
 
• "At night, lying sleepless, he considered sending messengers outside__ the country, secretly, in search of his friend."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
